description: Combine the 16-row packed grouped n=2048 plus deterministic n=256 global-best stack with the batch-aware two-CTA CuTe lower-macrotile n=2048 rank-k path and diagonal-block-only recurring cleanup. Preserve the packed upper-copy/cleanup memory phases and isolated MathDx panel factorization; import only compact staging, scheduler, lower updates, and safe diagonal clearing, then validate repeated outputs, caller-stream state, fresh inputs, and the full grid.

Imported compact FP16 grouped panel staging and the batch-aware two-CTA CuTe lower-macrotile rank-k scheduler while retaining the first parent deterministic n256 path and 16-row packed upper-copy/cleanup geometry. Recurring cleanup clears only each 256x256 diagonal block on zero-initialized pools. Build, policy gates, all 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, repeated pooled outputs, and all 15 benchmark cells passed; aggregate measured 936.079 us and batch-8 n2048 measured 2345.105 us versus the 929.538 us parent.

Kept the 16-row packed upper-copy and all deterministic factor/CuTe state unchanged, but packed recurring diagonal-block cleanup into eight warps per 256-thread CTA to match its smaller per-row write set. All policy, official, fresh-input, repeated-output, and full-grid checks passed; aggregate measured 938.281 us and batch-8 n2048 measured 2357.412 us versus 936.079/2345.105 for sixteen-warps.

Restored sixteen-warps for both packed memory phases and unrolled each lane by a second 32-vector stride in the upper-copy and diagonal-block cleanup kernels. The CuTe scheduler, compact half staging, isolated MathDx state, and all other dispatches remained unchanged. All validation and guards passed; aggregate measured 929.341 us, batch-8 n2048 reached 2306.790 us, and n256 measured 120.843 us versus 936.079/2345.105 for the initial combine.

Isolated the packed-memory unroll by restoring the first parent upper-copy loop and retaining a two-stride unroll only for recurring diagonal-block cleanup. All policy, official, fresh-input, repeated-output, and full-grid checks passed; aggregate measured 927.040 us and batch-8 n2048 reached 2281.072 us versus 929.341/2306.790 when both memory phases were unrolled and 936.079/2345.105 without unrolling.

Completed the packed-memory isolation by unrolling only the 16-row upper-copy loop and restoring normal-stride diagonal cleanup. Every validation and guard passed; aggregate measured 931.577 us and batch-8 n2048 measured 2306.142 us. This compares with 927.040/2281.072 for cleanup-only unrolling, 929.341/2306.790 for both loops, and 936.079/2345.105 for neither.

Returned to cleanup-only unrolling and fused each grouped TRSM plus compact FP16 panel conversion behind one caller-stream extension entrypoint, removing one Python extension dispatch per active panel. Validation passed, but the full benchmark sampled system-wide slow with long-tail outliers; aggregate measured 941.406 us and batch-8 n2048 averaged 2399.256 us with a 2317.840 us best run versus 927.040/2281.072 for separate entrypoints.

Byte-identical confirmation of the fused TRSM-plus-conversion entrypoint returned to normal-speed sampling after the outlier-heavy first run. Build and full validation reconfirmed unchanged correctness; aggregate measured 929.563 us and batch-8 n2048 measured 2307.889 us, still above the separate-entrypoint cleanup-only sample at 927.040/2281.072.

Restored separate TRSM/conversion entrypoints and cached all seven tight-prefix FP16 staging views when the n2048 workspace is allocated, replacing per-call slice/reshape metadata construction while preserving compact batch strides. All checks passed; aggregate measured 929.192 us and batch-8 n2048 measured 2292.058 us versus 927.040/2281.072 for on-demand views and 929.563/2307.889 for fused dispatch.

Restored on-demand tight-prefix views and compiled seven fixed n2048 rank-k stages with trailing size, batch, and all strides as CuTe constexprs, leaving only pointers and the caller queue at launch. Validation passed, while the full run sampled broadly slow; aggregate measured 941.846 us and batch-8 n2048 measured 2339.379 us versus 927.040/2281.072 for the generic launch.

Restored the generic CuTe rank-k launch and widened compact panel conversion from 32x8 to 32x16 threads, halving per-thread transpose work. Local extension build passed, but remote validation produced no test output for 1284 seconds versus the recorded 90-second envelope and was terminated; no correctness or benchmark metric was returned.

After restoring the validated 32x8 converter tree, changed compact panel transpose/conversion to 32x4 threads with eight elements per thread. Build, policy, official tests, fresh-input guard, repeated outputs, and all benchmark cells passed; aggregate measured 928.287 us and batch-8 n2048 measured 2284.065 us versus 927.040/2281.072 for 32x8. The complementary 32x16 run had timed out before validation returned.

Retried the 32x16 compact converter after the prior infrastructure timeout. Build and every policy/correctness/fresh-input check passed; aggregate measured 928.591 us and batch-8 n2048 measured 2286.084 us. The completed geometry sweep measured 927.040/2281.072 for 32x8, 928.287/2284.065 for 32x4, and 928.591/2286.084 for 32x16.

Restored the selected 32x8 compact converter with generic CuTe stage arguments and cleanup-only two-stride unrolling. Final clean build, all policy gates, 17 official tests, six fresh-input cases, repeated output reuse, and all 15 benchmark cells passed. Confirmation measured 929.025 us aggregate and 2291.878 us on batch-8 n2048; the same tree reached the brief best 927.040/2281.072 earlier.

Combined the packed grouped/deterministic parent with compact FP16 staging and batch-aware two-CTA CuTe updates across 13 measured trials. Best commit c15e680 reached 927.040 us aggregate and 2281.072 us at batch-8 n2048 versus the 929.538 us first parent; selected HEAD 7a904bc is byte-identical and reconfirmed at 929.025/2291.878. The exact combine was 936.079/2345.105. Cleanup-only unrolling beat eight-warp, both-loop, and upper-only variants; fused TRSM/conversion, cached views, constexpr stages, and 32x4/32x16 conversion geometries measured 929.563, 929.192, 941.846, 928.287, and 928.591 us in normal or noted noisy samples. Every succeeded design passed caller-stream policy, official tests, fresh inputs, repeated outputs, and the full grid; one 32x16 validation attempt timed out in infrastructure before its successful retry. Local profiling was waived and Brev unavailable. Keep this line moving with half2/vectorized transpose stores, a lower-overhead C++/driver launch bridge, or stage-specific host wrappers that retain the generic measured kernel body.
